subject: Customer Handshake: MAP & Implementation Playbook
messages:
From: Tom Ruiz <tom.ruiz@lighthousedata.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: onboarding@lighthousedata.com
Date: Mon, 9 Mar 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps — MAP & dates

Hi Monica / Irene,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team is excited. Ellen and I pulled together a preliminary internal timeline and a couple constraints to share before we lock dates:

- Data sampling window: week of 3/22 (security needs confirm)
- Integration window: target 4/5–4/16 (we have a release freeze the week of 4/12)
- Primary stakeholders: Ellen (Prod), me (Eng), K. Lopez (Security)

Can you send a mutual action plan (MAP) draft that aligns responsibilities and a suggested 6-week milestone plan? If you can add a short risk register that calls out the release-freeze overlap, that would be helpful.

Thanks — Tom

--
Tom Ruiz
Director, Platform Engineering
Lighthouse Data
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tom Ruiz <tom.ruiz@lighthousedata.com>, Ellen Park <ellen.park@lighthousedata.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Mar 2026 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Next steps — MAP & dates

Tom — appreciate the constraints. Attaching a first-pass MAP and a short implementation risk register.

High-level proposal (summary):
- Week 1 (3/22): Security review + data sample handoff (Lighthouse provides samples; Redwood validates ingestion) — Owners: Lighthouse (Ellen), Redwood (Priyom)
- Week 2 (3/29): Integration sprint: API keys, routing test endpoints — Owners: Redwood infra (Priyom) / Lighthouse eng (Tom)
- Week 3 (4/5): Model tuning/validation on sampled data — Owners: Redwood research (Irene) / Lighthouse data (Ellen)
- Week 4 (4/12): Acceptance testing window (note: client release freeze) — Owners: Joint; contingency: limited sandbox cutover
- Week 5 (4/19): Pre-production run and go/no-go review — Owners: Lighthouse PM + Redwood CSM
- Week 6 (4/26): Gradual production cutover + post-launch check-in

Open asks:
1) Finalize K. Lopez for security signoff and availability during 3/22 window.
2) Confirm whether the release-freeze is strict (no deployments) or if we can run sandbox validations within the freeze.

Attachments: LHD_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP spreadsheet), implementation_risk_register.pdf

Irene — looping you in to take point on the technical acceptance criteria and the go/no-go checklist. Priyom, please confirm infra owner names and whether you need any quota requests.

Thanks,
Monica

--
Monica Patel
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tom Ruiz <tom.ruiz@lighthousedata.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Mar 2026 09:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Next steps — MAP & dates

Thanks Monica — attached are a few acceptance criteria snippets I recommend we bake into the MAP under the 'validation' milestone:

- Ingestion: sample dataset of ~1000 rows ingested without schema mismatches (error rate < 0.5%)
- Latency: 95th percentile inference latency under 220ms on suggested config (quantized model)
- Quality: pass rate on smoke test prompts > 88% (we'll share prompt set)
- Security: data retention policy validated and a signed data handling appendix

Priyom — I can take lead on the quality tests and will prepare the smoke test prompt set by 3/27. Priyom, can you confirm whether dedicated capacity request for the 4/5 tuning window is needed vs. hosted burst? (If we need dedicated, we should surface procurement lead times now.)

Forwarding a short internal checklist: on-boarding playbook, keys, test endpoints, monitoring hooks, and rollback plan.

Best,
Irene

--
Irene Choi
Principal Applied ML Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Ruiz <tom.ruiz@lighthousedata.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Mar 2026 11:15:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Next steps — MAP & dates

Quick update from infra:
- Hosted burst capacity will cover validation and smoke tests on 4/5–4/9.
- If Lighthouse requires sustained high throughput during tuning, we recommend a 2-week Dedicated reservation; procurement lead time is ~10 business days.
- Quota ask: increase concurrent sessions for project DL-2026-0417 to 40 for the tuning window.

Action items for this thread (short):
1) Lighthouse: confirm whether tuning needs sustained dedicated capacity (Tom/Ellen)
2) Redwood: Priyom will provision test endpoints and share credentials by 3/24
3) Redwood: Irene will share smoke test prompts by 3/27
4) Both: agree final acceptance criteria in MAP v1 and sign off by 3/31

Attachments: kickoff-agenda.docx

—Priyom

Priyom Das
Implementation Lead, Redwood Inference
From: Ellen Park <ellen.park@lighthousedata.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Mar 2026 16:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Next steps — MAP & dates

Thanks all — quick replies inline: 

- We will keep the release-freeze for prod (no deployments 4/12–4/16). Sandbox validations during that week are OK if they don’t touch prod configs.
- We do NOT need dedicated capacity for tuning; hosted burst is fine for our expected volume. Tom and I will confirm exact times for the 4/5 tuning run (we prefer mornings PST).
- Confirm K. Lopez will be the security reviewer; CC'ing them on the separate security questionnaire thread.

Monica — MAP v1 looks good. Ellen to sign off on acceptance criteria after Irene's prompt set. Can we schedule a 30-minute kickoff on 3/25 to finalize signoffs?

Attaching: signed risk register (implementation_risk_register.pdf) and an updated MAP (LHD_MAP_v1.xlsx) with minor date tweaks.

Best,
Ellen Park
VP, Product Operations
Lighthouse Data
